sar.narrative: Customer C04776 used card C04776‑K1 to make a single online purchase of $100.00 on 20 November 2016 at 18:00:02. The transaction originated from a Windows 7 device running Chrome 65.0 with a screen resolution of 1916×901 and was routed through a transparent IP proxy (IP_PROXY:TRANSPARENT). The same device profile, which was new to the account, was also observed on two other customers’ cards, C00768‑K1, C00768‑K2 and C09149‑K1, each accessing the bank via the same proxy and sharing an additional iOS device profile (iOS 11.3.0, mobile Safari 11.0, 2436×1125). This cross‑customer device usage matches previously documented coordinated fraud cases CC‑5395 and CC‑4785. Situation‑memory analysis shows a 75 % fraud rate for alerts with identical device‑and‑proxy characteristics, far above the baseline fraud rate of 0.36 %. The low transaction amount and common billing region do not explain the activity, and the customer has denied authorizing the purchase, indicating the activity is suspicious.
